summary: Backend-only testing for saison-courante bug fix (iter 14). All 3 priority bugs verified fixed + 5 regressions passed. 21/21 pytest tests pass. Cleanup verified (no saison>20, no TEST_ residuals, balances restored to original values).
action_items: Image upload issue reported by user was NOT tested (context insufficient per request). Main agent should clarify with user which screen/context triggers the generic error.
Recommend adding a startup-time DB cleanup / migration to hard-delete any saison>20 docs that may still exist from other test envs.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/saisons-config/{saison} correctly returns 404 for out-of-range and does NOT persist parasite docs (fix at lines 4844-4845 verified).
config.pop('_id', None) at line 4859 correctly prevents ObjectId serialization error on freshly-created configs.
MAX_SAISON=20 is hardcoded in two places (saison-courante line 4820 and moyennes-dashboard line 5582). Consider extracting to a module-level constant to avoid drift.
payer_facture endpoint (line 2753) uses 'repartition' with caisse-name mapping — well-tested by regression 5.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test created a TEST_frac facture + split payment, then cleaned up (facture removed, transactions removed, balances restored, saison>20 purged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter 14 confirmed clean: no saison>20, no TEST_ transactions, no TEST_ factures, all 5 tested account balances match pre-test values (Compte Bancaire=826, PayPal=632, Chez Fabien=565, Chez Jacques=370, Dehors=480). Saison courante=14 verified. If future tests need to create saisons_config docs, ONLY use saisons in range 1-20 and always cleanup in finally block. Image upload bug is still pending clarification from user.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the original 'Saison 99' bug: previous testing_agent (iter 13) called GET /api/saisons-config/99 which created a parasite doc with saison=99 (before the range check). The /api/saison-courante endpoint then picked up saison=99 as the max non-locked season. Fix (already applied by main agent): (1) added 'saison <= 20' filter in saison-courante and moyennes-dashboard queries, (2) added 404 return + no-persist for out-of-range GET /saisons-config/{saison}, (3) added config.pop('_id') to prevent ObjectId serialization crash. All fixes verified working.
